preconditions.description: The matrix size N must be between 4 and 64 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= matrix[i][j] <= N**2 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix must be integers between 1 and N^2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == N and all(len(row) == N for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix must have exactly N rows and each row must have exactly N columns.

postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest number of operations required to sort the matrix.
